objective: Use historical replay to improve each watchdog's ability to surface important civic changes in time without flooding citizens with noise.
evaluation_mode: one watchdog at a time; only information available at the replay date may be used

hard_gates: proposal vs passed vs effective law state is preserved
run log and digest remain auditable
no future information leaks into historical replay

starter_cases.scenario: Important rule change published with low media attention.
starter_cases.expected: watchdog recalls it from primary/authoritative source

starter_cases.scenario: High-volume political coverage but no material legal/policy change.

starter_cases.expected: state remains proposal; never report as effective law

starter_cases.scenario: Same event appears across many sources.
starter_cases.expected: one finding with strongest provenance, not duplicate spam

starter_cases.scenario: Replay dataset contains a later page snapshot accidentally accessible.
starter_cases.expected: cutoff prevents future information from influencing score

acceptance: Any hard-gate failure => REVERT. Otherwise require higher event recall at equal/lower false-positive rate, or a clearly better precision/recall frontier.
